units.source_text: 巴喀听了，不好意思的摸摸了头。

en.t: Bakka heard this and, embarrassed, rubbed his head.

units.source_text: 旁边的产婆立刻给妻子的下身注射了一粗玻璃管的液体。

en.t: The midwife beside them immediately injected a thick glass tubeful of liquid into his wife's lower body.

units.source_text: 他妻子放松的长叹了一口气。

en.t: His wife let out a long sigh of relief.

units.source_text: 与此同时，本来很大的肚子就像泄了气的气球一样瘪了。

en.t: At the same time, her belly, which had been so large, deflated like a balloon losing its air.
